context.transcript:
We'd like to remind our listeners about this weekend's art fair.
Many local artists will be showing their work.
One of the feature artists is Emiko Ito, who is known for her modern furniture designs.
What makes her artwork special is that she recycles materials, such as rubber and plastic, to create her furniture pieces.
This is great for the environment.
I invited Miss Ito here for an interview.
After this short commercial break, Miss Ito will be discussing her creative process.
Thank you.
context.transcript_translation:
我们想提醒听众们关于本周末的艺术展。
许多本地艺术家将展示他们的作品。
其中一位特色艺术家是伊藤惠子，她以现代家具设计而闻名。
她的艺术品特别之处在于她回收材料，例如橡胶和塑料，来制作她的家具作品。
这对环境很好。
我邀请了伊藤小姐来这里进行一次采访。
在这次短暂的商业休息之后，伊藤小姐将讨论她的创作过程。
谢谢您。
